NOT_AN_APPROVAL: This is a SCIENTIFIC PROTOCOL for design review ONLY. There is deliberately NO approved execution record, NO launch packet, NO image digest, and NO code change bound here. Per the owner's two-review gate: (1) THIS design + the companion exposure inventory are reviewed first; (2) only after design approval are the machinery (shared wrapper, verifier language separation, confirmation-split minting) implemented and tested; (3) a SECOND review then binds the exact code sha, image digest, manifests and execution packets before anything launches. Sealed evaluation, promotion and deployment remain HELD throughout; this protocol defines only an unsealed DIRECTIONAL comparison that INFORMS a future, separately-predeclared hyperparameter selection.
purpose: Compare KD hyperparameter recipes for Arm-2 preservation-aware distillation against a matched KD-disabled control, to nominate at most one recipe to carry into a future full-Arm-2 training request. Directional and unsealed; not a promotion or qualification.

KD_CONTROL.role: matched control at identical budget/seed/data-order, so any preservation effect can be ATTRIBUTED to KD versus base under-training/drift (Codex round 31 finding 2b)

shared_wrapper_requirement: BOTH modes MUST run pipeline.omniasr_calibrate so both emit the SAME serving-readyz / upstream-parity / dev-WER / authoritative-verifier receipts and are comparable through one evidence pipeline. Post-approval implementation: remove the KD-enable entrypoint fork (scripts/b5_sagemaker_job.py) and the two KD-off short-circuits (omniasr_calibrate refusal + validate_arm2_semantics early return) so KD_CONTROL trains with distillation off but is otherwise gated identically (Codex round 31 finding 2a).

languages.verifier_change_required: the verifier's evaluated-languages-subset-of-preservation gate must be split into FOUR preservation languages (non-inferiority GATED) and SEVEN monitored/evaluated languages (three of which are RETENTION-gated); to be implemented post-approval (Codex round 31 finding 2b).

base_preservation_non_inferiority.reference: the FROZEN base teacher's WER per language on the confirmation split
base_preservation_non_inferiority.test: paired bootstrap; PASS iff the one-sided 95% upper bound of (WER_candidate - WER_base) <= +0.005 (0.5 absolute WER points) per language, after multiplicity correction

arm1_retention.reference: Arm-1's achieved per-language WER, to be PINNED from committed Arm-1 evaluation evidence (platform/evidence/receipts/ARM1-B5-2026-005-COMPLETION*) at confirmation-manifest mint time (predeclared before any run)
arm1_retention.test: paired bootstrap; PASS iff the one-sided 95% upper bound of (WER_candidate - WER_arm1_reference) <= +delta_pp per language, after multiplicity correction; delta_pp pinned at mint (proposed 0.5pp, subject to design review)

constraints.kd_attribution: every KD_CANDIDATE is compared DIRECTLY to the matched KD_CONTROL at identical step budget, seed and data order; a candidate must beat the control on the macro preservation objective to be creditable to KD, not to training

stage1_screen.purpose: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: drop configurations that diverge or grossly regress on the screening sentinels; NO winner is declared here (600 steps ~ 1.5% of the intended 40,000-step train, and Arm-1's Lingala regression only surfaced over thousands of steps)

stage2_confirm.run_type: FRESH from base (NOT continued from the Stage-1 screen checkpoints)
stage2_confirm.arms: H0 + the best 1-2 Stage-1 survivors + KD_CONTROL
stage2_confirm.matched: identical MEDZEN_SEED AND identical data ordering across every compared arm

stages.second_seed_replicate: the finalist AND the KD_CONTROL are EACH re-run under a second, matched MEDZEN_SEED to separate recipe effect from seed noise (not the finalist alone) (Codex round 31 finding 4)

statistics.metric: WER = sum(edit_distance) / sum(reference_words) per language, from the per-row edit-distance receipts
statistics.resampling: paired bootstrap, B >= 10000, the SAME resampled row indices applied to both arms in each comparison
statistics.units: absolute WER points (pp) — no relative-% ambiguity
statistics.multiplicity_correction: Holm-Bonferroni across the FULL family of (arm x language x constraint) one-sided tests at family-wise alpha = 0.05 (predeclared); a candidate must pass every constraint AFTER correction

selection_rule.qualify: a KD_CANDIDATE QUALIFIES iff, on the CONFIRMATION split and after multiplicity correction: (a) all 4 base-preservation non-inferiority constraints pass; AND (b) all 3 Arm-1-retention constraints pass; AND (c) it beats the matched KD_CONTROL on the macro preservation objective (one-sided 95% lower bound of (WER_control - WER_candidate) > 0); AND (d) it beats H0 similarly
selection_rule.tie_break: among qualifiers, DETERMINISTIC: (1) lowest macro preservation WER on the confirmation split; (2) ties -> lowest KD alpha; (3) ties -> lexicographically smallest recipe id
selection_rule.NO_RECIPE_QUALIFIES: if NO candidate qualifies, the outcome is the explicit terminal state NO_RECIPE_QUALIFIES -> no Arm-2 recipe change is nominated (hold), and a new design is predeclared; the protocol NEVER silently nominates the least-bad recipe

confirmation_data_rules.screening_set: the frozen dev sentinels (lingala + swahili exist today; english/french/pidgin/kinyarwanda/ewe to be minted post-approval) — used ONLY for Stage-1 screening and candidate selection

confirmation_split.status: NOT YET MINTED — minting is part of the post-approval implementation; see the companion exposure inventory B5-UNIVERSAL-ARM2-EXPOSURE-INVENTORY-2026-001
confirmation_split.source: the UNSELECTED remainder of each tier-2 dev pool (never the sealed promotion holdout)
rules: DISJOINT by audio_checksum_sha256 from: the 420 Arm-1 dev-selection rows, the lingala/swahili screening sentinels, all Arm-1/gb9 training data, and the sealed promotion holdout
NEVER surfaced during development, checkpoint selection, or Stage-1 screening
PREDECLARED + committed + FROZEN (per-row sha256 + per-pool S3 version_id/etag/KMS pins) BEFORE any finalist runs
opened ONCE, for the finalist + KD_CONTROL confirmation only
the sealed promotion holdout (HOLDOUT-GRADES-2026-001 / PROMOTION-PROTOCOL-2026-004) is NEVER touched by this protocol

budget.reservation: serial (one job reserved at a time)
budget.automatic_retries: NONE — any retry requires separate owner authorization
budget.fixed_overhead_note: ~1073 s per-job fixed overhead measured from the calibration is included in the budget
budget.reporting_rule: on-demand pricing always; +$100 on every reported max => reported max <= $160

two_review_gate.first_review: THIS design + the exposure inventory (status PENDING_DESIGN_REVIEW); no code, no packets, no launch
two_review_gate.second_review: AFTER implementation + tests: a review binding the exact code sha, trainer image digest, screening/confirmation manifests, and per-recipe execution packets — BEFORE any launch

holds: hyperparameter SELECTION output, sealed evaluation, promotion, and deployment ALL remain HELD for separate predeclared reviewed steps. This protocol authorizes NOTHING to run.
